applyTo: "**/*"

# Conventional Commits (all AI-generated commits)

When this repository involves git commits, pull request titles, or squash merge messages, use **Conventional Commits**.

Format: `<type>(<scope>): <description>`

Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`

Scopes: `frontend`, `backend`, `docs`, `db`, `infra`, `docker`, `deps`

Subject line: imperative, lowercase, no trailing period, ≤72 characters.

See `docs/CONVENTIONAL_COMMITS.md` for examples, breaking changes, and PR title rules.
